context.problem_statement: Validate an ETL pipeline by comparing source and target tables. Write SQL queries to: (1) compare row counts between source_transactions and target_transactions_cleaned tables, (2) compute null rates for each column in both tables, (3) identify rows in source that are missing from target (anti-join), (4) detect rows with value changes between source and target for the same primary key, (5) validate referential integrity: all customer_ids in target must exist in customers table. Produce a validation summary report.
context.expert_knowledge: ETL validation queries: COUNT(*) for row counts, SUM(CASE WHEN col IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) for null rates. Anti-join: WHERE NOT EXISTS (subquery) or LEFT JOIN ... WHERE target.id IS NULL. Value drift: JOIN on PK and compare columns with <> operator. Referential integrity: LEFT JOIN customers and check WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL.
